title: 模造された青空の、底に沈む
author: 御堂 レン

en.title: Sinking to the Bottom of a Fabricated Blue Sky
en.premise: "The sky is always transparently beautiful"—repeating these words to myself, I walk through the fog. In my hands are the "secret map" left behind by my daughter and a "broken sword" I once believed was worth protecting. I believe that if I reach the place pointed to by the map, the peace I thought I lost will return. Yet, the shadow of "something" creeping up from behind slowly and surely erodes my perception of reality.

zh.title: 沉于伪造青空之底
zh.premise: “天空总是清澈得美丽”——我一边这样对自己说，一边走在迷雾之中。手中握着的，是女儿留下的“秘密地图”，以及曾深信不疑应当守护的“断剑”。我相信，只要抵达地图所指引的地方，失去的平静就会失而复得。然而，从身后逼近的“某样东西”的影子，却正在一点一滴、切实地侵蚀着我的认知。
